name: Enosys Loans CDP
oneLiner: CDP is Enosys's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin on Flare, minted from Flare-ecosystem collateral via Enosys Loans CDP vaults.
collateral: FXRP, wFLR, sFLR, and stXRP deposited into Enosys Loans CDP positions on Flare, with collateral priced by the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO)
pegMechanism: Liquity V2 friendly fork: an overcollateralized CDP with user-set borrow interest rates, a Stability Pool that absorbs liquidations, and automated redemptions against the lowest-rate positions when CDP trades below its $1 peg; collateral is priced by the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: CDP is minted from Enosys Loans overcollateralized vaults on Flare when users deposit Flare-ecosystem collateral; the Enosys team administers the lending contracts and tunes collateral and liquidation parameters.

controls.label: Enosys Loans CDP contract (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-position overcollateralization against accepted Flare-ecosystem collateral, with liquidation and repayment rules.
controls.evidence: CDP is minted against Enosys Loans collateral and managed through liquidation and repayment rules, per Enosys docs.

controls.label: Enosys protocol admin
controls.evidence: Enosys administers the Loans contracts and configures accepted collateral and risk parameters; coin metadata flags centralized-dependent governance and a possible admin intervention surface.

review.evidence: Enosys docs describe an overcollateralized CDP on Flare minting the CDP stable against Enosys Loans collateral; the deployment is operator-administered with no on-chain renouncement confirmed.
review.sourceFreeRationale: CDP mechanism confirmed from Enosys docs; on-chain Loans contract admin owner and upgrade authority not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain Enosys Loans admin/owner and upgrade authority on Flare.
